input-not-found.title: Runbook: confirm every path on the command line, input AND output, then the file or directory behind it

invalid-input-data.title: Runbook: ask ffprobe what the file actually is before treating it as media

output-exists.title: Runbook: decide the overwrite policy, because -y and -n are different decisions about data

no-output-file.title: Runbook: find the missing output path in the argument list

odd-dimension.title: Fence: derive the width with -2, which rounds to even and cannot express an odd value
Runbook: round both axes explicitly when neither is derived

map-matches-no-stream.title: Heal: mark the stream selection optional with a trailing question mark
Runbook: keep the abort when a missing track means the input is wrong

unknown-encoder.title: Runbook: read the encoder list of the binary in hand, not of the version

filter-with-streamcopy.title: Heal: name a real video encoder, since a filtergraph requires re-encoding
Runbook: drop the filter instead, when only the container was meant to change

unknown-filter.title: Runbook: read the first line as the cause and the filter list of this build

undefined-filter-label.title: Runbook: check the label for both readings, undefined and already consumed

invalid-framerate.title: Runbook: trace the operand back to the variable that produced it

unrecognized-option.title: Runbook: match the quoted name against the option list of this version
